    Full subquivers and restriction of push-downs #

    For a finite quiver D and a finite set T of vertices, fullSub D T is the full subquiver on T. A morphism p : D → Q restricts to fullSubHom p T. A representation X of D restricts to X.res T; if X vanishes outside T, the push-down action of kQ on X.res T is the conjugate of that on X by extension by zero (pdAct_res), so relations killing the push-down of X kill that of X.res T (pdAct_res_eq_zero).
